title: Ampere Primus High Speed (Sport Black)
description: The Ampere Electric (Greaves) Ampere Primus High Speed (Sport Black) is crafted for effortless city navigation and exceptional fuel economy, positioned in the Urban Electric Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
